Organism group.reasoning: This column names the group studied, not a specific insect taxon.
Organism group.reasoning_relevance: Names the group of organisms studied, which is a biological classification.

Variable.reasoning: This column names the specific property or trait being measured for the organism.
Variable.reasoning_relevance: Represents environmental or garden characteristics, not a trait of the organism.

FDis df.reasoning: This column provides the degrees of freedom for the statistical test.
FDis df.reasoning_relevance: This is a statistical degree of freedom, not a measurement of the organism.

FDis F.reasoning: This column provides the calculated F-statistic value.
FDis F.reasoning_relevance: This is a test statistic, not a measurement of the organism.

FDis p.reasoning: This column provides the p-value for the statistical test.
FDis p.reasoning_relevance: This is a statistical p-value, not a measurement of the organism.

FEve df.reasoning: This column provides the degrees of freedom for the effect test.
FEve df.reasoning_relevance: This is a statistical degree of freedom, not a measurement of the organism.

FEve F.reasoning: This column provides the calculated F-statistic value for the effect.
FEve F.reasoning_relevance: This is a test statistic, not a measurement of the organism.

FEve p.reasoning: This column provides the p-value for the effect test.
FEve p.reasoning_relevance: This is a statistical p-value, not a measurement of the organism.
